own_solution.law: Q = mc(T_final - T_initial) = mcΔT and t = Q/P. Thus t = 2 × 4186 × 40 / 1500 = 223.2533333333 s. Adding q kilograms at the same initial temperature gives t = (2 + q) × 4186 × 40 / 1500.
assumptions: All heater power heats the water, with no heat losses or additional thermal load.
Specific heat capacity remains constant at the stated value.
The water remains liquid throughout heating.

Phase-change boundaries limit that model's applicability but do not invalidate the cancellation or the supplied temperature values, which remain in the liquid regime at ordinary atmospheric pressure.
